description: Agent Claims: submit a subrogation demand with the claim payment record and the claim record: the demand with its reference, the claim number it cites, the party it holds responsible, the currency, the total it seeks, the insured’s deductible it includes stated apart, each item it seeks to recover with its id, the item and the amount, and the day of loss it names; the payment record with its claim number, the currency and each payment with its id, the day paid, the item it covered and the amount; the claim record with its claim number, the party it holds responsible and the day of loss. The signed report gives the demand, the payments and the claim, the amount demanded against the sum paid plus the deductible stated apart, the responsible party against the claim record, and each item demanded read against the items the payments covered with the amount paid on each, and counts them, and names a divergent demand: a demand amount unlike what was actually paid or in another currency, a responsible party unlike the claim record, recovery claimed on an item no payment covered and an item demanded above what was paid on it; then a total unlike the demand’s own items, another day of loss and another claim number, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No payments, a payment with no amount, no demand amount or no responsible party on either record leaves those points unverified. Amounts compare to the cent in one currency, items read by their words with plurals folded, and parties without case, punctuation or a legal suffix. This reads the demand against what the claim record shows was paid. Verdict claims_subrogation_divergent, claims_subrogation_partial, claims_subrogation_unverified or claims_subrogation_consistent. POST /api/claims-subrogation-check. Reads the claim records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads consistency between claim documents only: it never files or submits a claim, never negotiates or pays one and never decides coverage, which stays with the insurer, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Claims reads claim records across the claim lifecycle for consistency between the claim documents and the policy they claim under: a first notice of loss, a sworn proof of loss, an adjuster’s report, a repair or replacement estimate, a settlement offer and release, a denial letter, a subrogation demand and a claim payment record, each against the policy, the first notice, the inspection record and claim file, the approved scope, the claim valuation, the claim record, the payment record or the settlement or adjudication it should agree with. The family is sector-neutral across property, casualty and liability claims and reads different claim documents against each other and against the policy. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-claims-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-claims/.
